title: Open Road
intro: This is the base that gets your legs back between points. You get about twenty-five seconds, and your body spends them recovering on oxygen. That's the engine this session builds. It needs shoes and a bit of flat road, nothing else, so it fits into almost any week.

Run for twenty-eight minutes at one pace. You should be able to say a full sentence out loud the whole way. If you can't, slow down. Harder than that and it stops being this session, so no surges and no fast finish. Running puts braking through your legs, and court days give you plenty already. In a heavy court week, do Engine Builder on the bike instead.

before.label: Not today
before.text: If a shin, foot, ankle or knee is sore right now, ride a bike or walk instead and get it looked at.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: A sharp pain, pain that spreads, numbness, or a joint that gives way.

before.label: Stop now
before.text: Chest pain, dizziness, a heartbeat that races or skips, or breathing that doesn't feel right. Get it looked at before you train again. Told to be careful with hard exercise? Check with your doctor first.
